title: Dr. Strangelove - Precious Bodily Fluids
summary: A three-minute clip from Dr. Strangelove in which Mandrake and Ripper (Peter Sellers and Sterling Hayden) discuss fluoridation and 'precious bodily fluids'. It is a famous Cold War satire scene.
why: HN uses it as a joke reference whenever commenters mock conspiracy-minded worries about purity or poisoning; nobody recommends it as a video to learn from.
